item.title: SCP-5298: Karmic cops' entrapment agents?
item.content:encoded: With the Three Moons entities having this kind of anomaly-busting tech, you'd think they'd be on friendlier terms with the Foundation — possibly even collaborate to take nightmare creatures down.

item.title: SCP-5942:
item.content:encoded: Grossly overpowered, even for s world-ending skip; this creature needs an Achilles' heel of some kind to balance its near-unstoppable broad spectrum of offensive and defensive capabilities.

item.title: SCP-4877: Re: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
I noticed a small problem — the source link for the first image (Cliffs of Moher) was disabled. Apparently the photographer has deleted the image from Flickr.

Normally Creative Commons license cannot be revoked, but the discussion page does not specify under what kind of license the first image was originally released so far. If you have a screenshot of the image license at the time you posted this article, or something like that, would you mind sharing it with us?

If you don't have such a thing, I would like to suggest looking for an alternative image.

item.title: SCP-1000: Are some of them immortal?
item.content:encoded:
So, they somehow remember their pasts of 10000 years past, does the memory of their extinction became somehow an instict of theirs? Or they were telling their children about the Day of the Flowers?
Did another organization like Chaos Insurgency or Serpent's Hand remind them? Or maybe some elite of them had access to something like Scp-006, they hide and now those elites get to lead their people again?
